convenciones.watts: positive = generates power, negative = consumes power
convenciones.capacidad_wh: batteries only (energy storage in watt-hours); 0 for everything else
convenciones.slots: fairing slots: how much space the part takes inside the rocket's payload fairing
convenciones.calor: heat the part gives off, scale 0-10 (low=2, medium=4, high=7, extreme=10; 0 = none)
convenciones.requiere: ALL ids in the list must be on the ship
convenciones.requiere_alguno_de: at least ONE id in the list must be on the ship
convenciones.incompatible: the listed ids cannot be combined with this part
convenciones.sinergia: ids of parts or mission-objective tags (e.g. mapeo_orbital) that give a bonus
convenciones.vulnerable_a: ids of events that damage the part (see eventos_sugeridos)
convenciones.penalizaciones: list of rules. {si_falta: id} or {si_falta_ninguno_de: [ids]}; if the condition is not met, 'efecto' applies
convenciones.ids: lowercase, no accents, underscores. Must match the key. Must be identical across all team files
convenciones.tags: capabilities of the part. A mission can require a tag (any part with it will do) or a specific id
convenciones.alcance_ua_max: optional (antennas): maximum communication distance in astronomical units (AU)
convenciones.solo_mision: optional: 'humana' (crewed) or 'robotica' (robotic). The part only applies to that mission type
convenciones.requiere_aterrizaje: optional: true = only works if the mission includes a landing (aterrizaje=true in missions.json)
convenciones.mitiga: optional: ids of events whose damage the part reduces or cancels
convenciones.ciencia_base: optional (instruments): science points per use turn. Game value
convenciones.aporta_capacidad_masa: engines and boosters only: adds to lift capacity (game units)
convenciones.masa_cuenta_como_carga: if false, its mass does not count as load to lift (default true)
convenciones.isp_vacio_real_s: real specific impulse in vacuum (s); informational only
convenciones.resumen: short one-line text shown in the hover tooltip

meta.regla_distancia_solar: real_power = watts * (1 / distance_in_AU^2). Mars (~1.5 AU) gets about 43% of Earth's sunlight, Jupiter (~5.2 AU) about 4%. Only applies to parts with depende_del_sol = true.
supuestos: Data for thermal control, life support and payload comes from the team's table; it was not verified against NASA sources.
Heat level: 0 for passive thermal parts; heater 2, scrubber 4, lighting 2 (assumed).
Slots assumed: scrubber 1, water and food 2, shielding 1.
ciencia_base values for instruments are game values (proposed).
TRL of MLI, radiator, heater and life support assumed to be 9.

camara_optica.descripcion: A lightweight instrument that photographs and maps surfaces in visible light, like a very precise camera on a satellite.
camara_optica.efecto_juego: Steady, moderate science output when the ship is well oriented. Fragile during launch vibration.

espectrometro_masas.descripcion: Identifies the chemical makeup of atmospheres and surfaces by sorting molecules according to their mass.
espectrometro_masas.resumen: Reveals what atmospheres and rocks are made of.
espectrometro_masas.efecto_juego: Large science bonus on composition objectives. Its mass calls for a more powerful rocket.

radar_sar.descripcion: Sends radio pulses and listens to the echoes to measure terrain height, map the ground through thick clouds and even look beneath ice.
radar_sar.resumen: Maps terrain through clouds and ice. Power hungry.
radar_sar.efecto_juego: Massive science in hostile environments (dense atmospheres), but its power draw forces heavy investment in the power system.
radar_sar.notas: A lone RTG (110 W) cannot sustain 120 W: the ship's watt balance must stay at or above 0, or a battery must be added.

sismografo.descripcion: A very sensitive instrument that measures ground vibrations: quakes, moonquakes or meteorite impacts on a planetary surface.
sismografo.efecto_juego: Continuous science data after a successful landing.
sismografo.notas: Phase 2 if today's mission is orbit-only. Source cited by the team: Lunar Seismic Event Catalog (unverified).

brazo_robotico.descripcion: A mechanical manipulator for collecting samples, drilling into rock or interacting with the surroundings.
brazo_robotico.efecto_juego: Essential for sample-return and advanced surface missions. Its mass makes the launcher more expensive.
brazo_robotico.notas: The -25 W is drawn only while the arm is in use. Phase 2 if the mission is orbit-only.
